title: Five years of psychokinesis experiments could never isolate the target

tellings.quote: we did uh five years of experiments to prove psychokinesis

plain: Joe McMoneagle, a former US Army man who took part in research on psychic abilities, says his group spent five years running experiments to prove psychokinesis, the idea that the mind can move or affect objects. He tells Michels "we did uh five years of experiments to prove psychokinesis" and says they could never pin down exactly what the effect was acting on. In his telling, the failure was about isolating the target, not about whether something was happening at all.
